criteria.requirement: Implement cattrs.strategies.sequence_union.configure_sequence_union(converter, union) as opt-in actual union-hook registration for exactly one list/tuple/Sequence branch and one attrs/dataclass/dict record branch. Mapping input selects the record, non-text Sequence selects the sequence, then delegate every nested conversion to current converter hooks. Support empty/tuple input and nested custom hooks, reject text/bytes/generators and ambiguous branch sets explicitly, and leave other union/default behavior unchanged.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
